Container.Name: mover5:cleanrr
Container.Overview: Torrent lifecycle manager for Deluge. Automatically removes torrents after a configurable seed duration, with a web dashboard for monitoring and management.
Container.Description: Python-based torrent lifecycle manager for Deluge. Connects to Deluge via its Web API, tracks all torrents in a local database, and auto-removes them after a configurable seed time (default 14 days). Features a web dashboard (port 9494) with torrent status, countdown timers, protection from auto-removal, and manual removal. Configurable check interval and seed duration via the UI.
